name: browser-use
headline: ccowl Claude Code monitor tool
short_description: A cross-platform status bar application that monitors Claude Code usage and session costs in real-time. Ideal for developers tracking API spending.
author: sivchari

sections.overview:
CCOwl is a cross-platform status bar application that displays Claude Code session costs and usage metrics in real-time. It automatically refreshes every 5 seconds and shows detailed information including burn rates, token usage, and projected final costs when clicked. The app supports macOS and Ubuntu/Linux, integrating with the Claude Code CLI to provide developers with immediate visibility into their API spending. Status indicators display burn rate severity (low, moderate, high) to help developers monitor usage patterns. Setup requires the Claude Code CLI and ccusage command to be installed and configured.
Monitor Claude Code API costs during active coding sessions
Track token burn rates and spending patterns in real-time
View session timing and projected final costs at a glance
Identify high-usage periods with status bar alerts
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sivchari/ccowl`
sections.usage:
```
Create a ccowl dashboard for [COMPANY] that tracks Claude Code usage across [NUMBER] developers. Include metrics like monthly API calls, cost per developer, and code execution time. Format the output as a real-time status bar application.
```
Copy

```
# ccowl Dashboard for TechInnovate Solutions

- **Total API Calls (Last 30 Days):** 12,456
- **Average Cost per Developer:** $42.78
- **Average Execution Time:** 1.2 seconds
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
